# Baron Boutique

> Baron Boutique is an independent bespoke tailoring house founded in Kathmandu, Nepal in 2000. Baron Boutique has spent over 25 years creating bespoke garments with a focus on artisanal craftsmanship, dramatic design, and collector-quality tailoring. From cinematic-inspired coats and formalwear to handcrafted cashmere products, every garment is made with precision, individuality, and attention to detail.

Tailored products are made to each customer's measurements by human tailors, with a free test garment before the final is cut. There is no off-the-rack inventory. 15,000+ clients served. Worldwide tracked shipping.

Screen-inspired garments are recreations based on screen references, not licensed merchandise. Verify prices and timelines on product pages.

Links below point to plain markdown wherever a markdown version exists, and to the human page otherwise. Every product, category, guide, service and policy page also has a markdown version at its own URL with `index.md` appended, for example `https://baronboutique.com/menswear/tuxedos/index.md`, advertised on the page as `rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"` with `rel="describedby"` pointing back to this file.

## What you can do with this document

- Identify what Baron Boutique makes and how its made-to-order tailoring works.
- Look up products, prices, materials, and customization options by category.
- Answer questions about ordering, measurements, shipping, returns, and payment.
- Cite the official baronboutique.com URLs provided for every product, category, service, and policy.

## Construction and Craft

- [Construction](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/construction.md): How Baron Boutique builds the final garment, and how the workshop decides between canvas types, hand work, and machine work for each project.
- [Fittings](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/fittings.md): How Baron Boutique reads fit from customer photos, translates plain-language feedback into corrections, and decides when the fit is final.
- [Pattern Drafting](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/pattern-drafting.md): How Baron Boutique drafts an individual pattern from scratch for each commission, and how it decides proportions when the reference picture and the customer's body disagree.
- [Trial Garment (Toile)](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/trial-garment-toile.md): Why Baron Boutique ships a test garment before cutting the final fabric, what it is made from, and how the workshop decides when one is enough.

## Fabric and Materials

- [Dupioni Silk](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/dupioni-silk.md): Why Dupioni silk is a Baron Boutique signature for occasion garments, and the one question that decides whether we recommend it.
- [How We Choose Fabric](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/fabric-selection.md): How Baron Boutique advises fabric, starting from the customer's objective rather than the cloth, with the workshop's reasoning on weight, climate, and trade-offs.
- [Linen and Himalayan Hemp](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/linen-and-himalayan-hemp.md): How Baron Boutique decides between linen and Himalayan hemp, and the single question about wrinkles that usually decides it.
- [Velvet](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/velvet.md): How Baron Boutique chooses among velvets for frock coats, evening jackets, and gowns, what velvet demands in the workshop, and how to live with a velvet garment for years.
- [Understanding Wool](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/wool.md): How Baron Boutique chooses among worsted, tropical, flannel, tweed, and boiled wool, categorized by the problems each solves rather than by technical definitions.

## Measurement and Fit

- [Bust Measurement](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/bust-measurement.md): Where the bust measurement is actually taken, why Baron Boutique asks for bra size as well, and what a wrong bust number does to a garment.
- [Fit, Ease, and Why Correct Measurements Can Still Feel Wrong](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/fit-ease-and-why-numbers-feel-wrong.md): Why a garment cannot equal the body measurement, how Baron Boutique diagnoses a waist that pulls at the hips, and what fabric does to fit.
- [Hip and Thigh Measurement](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/hip-and-thigh-measurement.md): Why Baron Boutique does not use a fixed distance below the waist for hips, how to take the thigh, and why trousers punish a hip error hardest.
- [Measurement](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/measurement.md): How Baron Boutique collects, verifies, and reuses customer measurements for remote bespoke tailoring, and how experience catches the numbers that lie.
- [The Natural Waist](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/natural-waist-measurement.md): The difference between the natural waist and the waistband measurement, how to find each, and why "waist" alone is never enough information.
- [Women's Self-Measurement](https://baronboutique.com/okf/concepts/womens-self-measurement.md): How Baron Boutique asks women to measure themselves at home, and why preparation decides whether the numbers describe the body or the clothing.

## Collections

- [Handcrafted Cashmere](https://baronboutique.com/handmade-cashmere-collection/index.md): Handwoven cashmere scarves, shawls, and sweaters made by hand in Nepal from fiber sourced on the Tibetan Plateau.
- [Men](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/index.md): Bespoke menswear cut from an individual pattern after each order, covering suits, formalwear, outerwear, shirts, and accessories.
- [Men › Accessories](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-accessories/index.md): Hand-finished silk neckties, pocket squares, aviator scarves, and cashmere scarves, made in the workshop rather than sourced from stock.
- [Men › Coats & Overcoats](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-coats-and-overcoats/index.md): Made-to-order overcoats, topcoats, peacoats, and car coats in wool and cashmere, cut to the wearer's shoulders and chosen length.
- [Men › Dinner Jackets](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/dinner-jackets/index.md): Made-to-order dinner jackets in velvet, silk, and patterned cloth, cut to the wearer's measurements as an alternative to a standard black tuxedo.
- [Men › Frock Coats](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/frock-coats-for-men/index.md): Made-to-order frock coats in wool and velvet with a true waist seam and full skirt, for weddings, stage, historical dress, and collectors.
- [Men › House of Velvet](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/velvet/index.md): Made-to-order velvet jackets and coats in premium velvet on a canvas front, from dinner jackets and smoking jackets to dramatic frock coats.
- [Men › Pants](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-pants/index.md): Made-to-order trousers in wool, flannel, linen, mohair, and silk, cut from the wearer's rise, seat, and leg rather than a waist size.
- [Men › Real Silk Eventwear](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-silk-suits-shirts-ties-scarves/index.md): Made-to-order suits, shirts, and trousers in genuine dupioni, raw, satin, and noil silk, with hand-finished silk ties, pocket squares, and scarves.
- [Men › Shirts](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/shirts/index.md): Made-to-order dress shirts in Egyptian cotton, raw silk, and satin silk, cut to the wearer's neck and body rather than to a collar size.
- [Men › Suits & Blazers](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/mens-suits-blazers/index.md): Made-to-order suits and blazers cut from an individual pattern in wool, silk, mohair, and linen, from two-piece business suits to unstructured blazers.
- [Men › Tuxedos](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/tuxedos/index.md): Made-to-order tuxedos in wool with peak, shawl, or notch lapels, cut to the wearer's measurements and owned rather than rented.
- [Men › Vests](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/vests/index.md): Made-to-order waistcoats in wool, linen, and velvet, cut to the wearer's measurements to complete a three-piece suit or to wear alone.
- [Men › Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/wedding-suits/index.md): Made-to-order wedding suits for grooms, cut from an individual pattern, including three-piece, linen, and destination-wedding tailoring.
- [Men › Wedding Suits › Destination Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/wedding-suits/destination-wedding-suits/index.md): Made-to-order wedding suits for grooms marrying abroad, cut for heat and travel in fresco wool and linen, including cape suits and statement coats.
- [Men › Wedding Suits › Linen Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/menswear/wedding-suits/grooms-linen-suits-for-wedding/index.md): Made-to-order linen wedding suits for grooms in 100% linen across 18 colors, as two-piece, three-piece, or frock coat, for beach and summer ceremonies.
- [Screen Inspired](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/index.md): Garments recreated from film and television references and cut to each wearer's measurements. These are independent recreations, not officially licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Cinema Classics](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/cinema-classics/index.md): Golden-age and heist-film tailoring recreated in real cloth, from mid-century grey suits to rusty-tan three-pieces, cut to measurement. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Cyberpunk Trench Coats](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/cyberpunk-trench-coats/index.md): Floor-length structured cotton and leather trench coats recreated from screen references, cut to the wearer's measurements. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Doctor Collection](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/doctor-collection/index.md): Time traveler frock coats, velvet coats, and pinstripe suits recreated from screen references and cut to measurement. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Spy Tailoring](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/spy-tailoring/index.md): Secret-agent tailoring recreated as real clothing: pinstripe three-piece suits, naval peacoats, silk dinner jackets, and suede blousons. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Theatrical Villain](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/theatrical-villain-tailoring/index.md): Villain outerwear and evening tailoring recreated in genuine cloth, from purple double-breasted coats to burgundy three-piece suits. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Screen Inspired › Victorian Detective](https://baronboutique.com/screen-inspired/victorian-detective/index.md): Nineteenth-century detective outerwear recreated as wearable tailoring: frock coats and Ulster coats with true waist seams and full skirts. Not licensed merchandise.
- [Women](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/index.md): Bespoke womenswear cut from an individual pattern after each order, covering suits, dresses, formalwear, outerwear, and accessories.
- [Women › Accessories](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/womens-accessories/index.md): Handwoven cashmere scarves and shawls and hand-finished silk wraps, made in the workshop with color and dimensions specified per order.
- [Women › Coats & Overcoats](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/coats-and-overcoats-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order coats, topcoats, and frock coats in wool and cashmere, cut to the wearer's measurements for shoulder line and length.
- [Women › Dresses](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/dresses-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order dresses in wool flannel, crepe silk, and other cloths, cut to the wearer's measurements for work, evening, and occasion.
- [Women › Pants](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/pants-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order trousers cut to the wearer's waist and hip together, in seasonless wool, linen, and velvet, without the off-the-rack compromise.
- [Women › Screen Inspired](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/screen-inspired-women/index.md): Garments recreated from film and television references and drafted for a woman's figure. Independent recreations, not licensed merchandise.
- [Women › Shirts & Blouses](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/shirts-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order shirts and blouses in Egyptian cotton, oxford, twill, and crepe silk, cut across the shoulders, bust, and waist.
- [Women › Skirts](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/skirts-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order pencil, pleated, and stripe skirts cut to the wearer's waist, hip, and length for work and occasion wear.
- [Women › Suits & Blazers](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/suits-blazers-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order suits and blazers drafted for a woman's figure, in wool, silk, and linen, from pinstripe pant suits to sculpted single blazers.
- [Women › Sweaters](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/womens-cashmere-sweaters/index.md): Hand-knitted Grade A cashmere sweaters made to order in Nepal, with color and proportions specified per order rather than chosen from stock.
- [Women › Tuxedos](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/tuxedos-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order tuxedos drafted from scratch for a woman's shoulders, bust, and waist rather than resized from a man's pattern.
- [Women › Wedding Suits](https://baronboutique.com/womenswear/wedding-suits-for-women/index.md): Made-to-order wedding suits and tuxedos drafted for a woman's figure, for brides, guests, and mothers of the bride and groom.

## Services

- [Private Label](https://baronboutique.com/private-label/index.md): Baron Boutique produces cashmere knitwear, handwoven cashmere accessories and tailored garments for established fashion brands under the brand's own label.
- [Custom Cashmere Gifts](https://baronboutique.com/custom-cashmere-gifts/index.md): Baron Boutique offers a bespoke cashmere gifting service for life's most meaningful occasions, including weddings, corporate milestones, baby showers, and personal celebrations.
- [Retail Partnerships](https://baronboutique.com/retailers-wholesale-program/index.md): Baron Boutique partners with boutique retailers, specialty stores, and online retailers worldwide, producing custom tailored menswear, womenswear, screen-inspired garments, and handwoven cashmere to…
- [Designer Program](https://baronboutique.com/designer-program/index.md): Baron Boutique's Designer Program produces garments for emerging and independent fashion designers with a minimum order of one piece.
- [Natural Hemp Fabric & Clothing](https://baronboutique.com/100-natural-fiber-himalayan-hemp-fabric/index.md): Baron Boutique produces 100% natural hemp fabric and hemp clothing from hemp grown between 1,500m and 3,000m in the Nepal Himalayas without pesticides, herbicides or synthetic fertilizers.
- [Custom Corporate Gifts](https://baronboutique.com/custom-corporate-gifts/index.md): Baron Boutique produces branded corporate cashmere gifts to order: scarves, shawls, wraps and pashminas, hand-knitted beanies, gloves and socks, throws, and boxed gift sets.
- [Our Services](https://baronboutique.com/our-services/index.md): Baron Boutique operates as a made-to-order tailoring house. Every garment is cut after it is ordered, to one person's measurements, in the fabric they chose, and no ready-made stock is held.
